lines: (even if you never skip a session)
cover.sub: Number 5 is the one most lifters get wrong.

reasons.head: You lift the same weights every week
reasons.sub: Muscles adapt fast. If the weight or reps never go up, they have no reason to grow.

reasons.head: You stop your sets way too early
reasons.sub: The closer a set gets to failure, the more muscle it tends to build. Easy sets build less.

reasons.head: You train each muscle once a week
reasons.sub: A big review found that hitting each muscle twice a week builds more than once.

reasons.head: You're short on sleep
reasons.sub: In one study, a single night without sleep cut muscle building by 18%.

reasons.head: You're not eating enough to grow
reasons.sub: Muscle needs a small calorie surplus. Eyeballing your meals makes it easy to fall short.
